lede: Buffalo carries a full EdgeDesk team rating at -9.6; Robert Morris is not one of the 138 FBS programmes EdgeDesk rates, so the comparison is one-sided by construction rather than by judgement.
EdgeDesk makes it Buffalo -16.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Buffalo winning 86% of simulations.

The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; Robert Morris is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 57% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
